library.name: SNMP_Embedded
library.author: syntax <yard_botch.6g@icloud.com>
library.sentence: Memory-safe SNMPv2c agent with derived compile-time sizing and built-in system group.
library.paragraph: A full SNMPv2c agent: GET/GETNEXT/GETBULK/SET, v1/v2c TRAP and INFORM. Varbind cap and pool size are derived from the packet budget and your handler count (no magic numbers); the memory arena is locked in at boot so long-running nodes never fragment. Stateless trap/inform sends, loud tooBig rejection instead of silent drops, CI-validated (arduino-lint, host Catch2 suite, ESP8266+ESP32 example matrix).
